text: Toronto is the centre of the Canadian music industry and one of the world's premier cities for music. With a thriving music ecosystem that includes a robust complement of iconic live music venues and globally recognized festivals, as well as record companies, recording studios, music publishers, artist management and talent agencies, Toronto also attracts internationally renowned acts while consistently producing some of the world's top musicians across a range of genres. At the core of Toronto's music scene are its artists. A diverse and thriving grassroots music scene fosters talent development at all stages, enabling career growth for local emerging artists. Music rehearsal spaces are a vital part of this artist development trajectory. They provide safe, affordable, and accessible places for musicians to hone their craft.
